# Next Digital Level

> Performance marketing agency for Australian businesses. Next Digital Level brings established businesses calls, quote requests and bookings, and guarantees eligible businesses a fixed monthly volume, set with the client after a free audit.

- Founder: Amin Hamdi. A Swiss company with no middleman: clients deal directly with the founder.
- Where: all of Australia: Melbourne, Sydney, Brisbane, the Gold Coast, Perth, Adelaide and regional areas.
- Channels, each offered as a separate service: Google Ads (Google Ads Certified Partner), local SEO and Google Maps, Meta advertising (Meta Business Partner). The free audit picks the channel that will pay off most.
- Price: tailored, set in the free audit. No lock-in contract. Ad budget included on Google Ads and Meta. A website or page that converts is included.
- Enquiries are exclusive: never shared with or resold to a competitor.
- Clients: construction and renovation, property, health and clinics, hospitality, industry, professional services.
- Google reviews: 5.0 out of 5.
- Contact: +61 488 894 068 · contact@nextdigitalevel.com · https://wa.me/61488894068 · 475 Spencer St, West Melbourne VIC 3003 · available 7 days a week.
